versions.changelog:
thai-chinese-gov-efficiency v1.0.0

- Initial release for comparative analysis of governance structures and educational efficiency in Thai and Chinese public business schools.
- Supports building theoretical frameworks, mixed-methods research design, and workflow management for longitudinal academic studies.
- Integrates tools for literature review, data collection, statistical analysis, and quality assurance.
- Enables multi-agent coordination and milestone tracking for academic research projects.
